name: three-forma-styli
description: TypeScript-first design token generator with luminance-based color control

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @three-forma-styli/core test && pnpm --filter @three-forma-styli/compiler test && pnpm --filter @three-forma-styli/cli test
scripts.check:packages: publint packages/core && publint packages/themes && publint packages/compiler && publint packages/cli
scripts.check: pnpm check:versions && pnpm build:all && pnpm check:split && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @three-forma-styli/preview check
scripts.check:release: pnpm check && pnpm check:packages && node scripts/verify-packed-release.mjs && pnpm check:ecosystem

author: three
